mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT continue to move upward from their still-depressed levels, commuting-linked foot traffic will recover and RETAIL_REC will rise over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-4-week mean after four weeks even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both increase for at least two consecutive weekly observations.

mechanism_narrative: A short-run pull toward shopping districts occurs when RESIDENTIAL stops rising and people spend less time at home, which lifts retail visits within one week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 12% and declines week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within one week after RESIDENTIAL crosses below 12% and turns down from the prior week.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS rebounds after a prior weekly slump, the same leisure-weather impulse should also support retail outings, producing a two-week rise in RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: PARKS increases by more than 5 points week-on-week after a prior decline
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve over the next two weeks after PARKS posts a rebound of more than 5 points from the previous week.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains deeply suppressed while WORKPLACES stay below baseline, the area is still operating under restricted movement, and retail mobility will stay weak over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -30 and WORKPLACES stays below -20 for two straight weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its recent 4-week average despite both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remaining under the stated thresholds for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A synchronized rise in GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC would indicate broader errands replacing pure homebound behavior; because grocery trips cluster with shopping, the retail series should increase next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise in the next week when GROCERY_PHARM increases while RESIDENTIAL is flat or falling.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in RESIDENTIAL alongside weak TRANSIT means people are substituting local/home activity for discretionary shopping, which should push RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises for two consecutive weeks while TRANSIT remains below -33
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the prior four weeks after the stated residential-up/transit-low pattern persists for two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, a recovery in PARKS together with WORKPLACES signals broader mobility normalization, and retail activity should follow within two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or falls over the next two weeks even though PARKS and WORKPLACES both trend upward in the reopening regime.

mechanism_narrative: When grocery and park mobility both retreat at the same time, it usually reflects a broad demand slowdown that also lowers discretionary shopping over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both fall week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not underperform its last-4-week mean after both GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS decline in the same week.
